title_en: Locating a Lost Submersible with a Recovery-Aware Readiness Plan
title_zh: 漂移潜艇：搜索路线与救援准备
assessment_en: Uncalibrated author-external AI opinion: Outstanding-centered, adjacent Finalist–Outstanding. The complete initial manuscript and original problem were reviewed; the current 23-page paper was reread with all actual pages and native views of the added cost, route, reproduction and memorandum material. Administrative closeout exceeded the registered 20-minute review window.
assessment_zh: 作者外 AI 未校准参考意见：Outstanding 中心、相邻 Finalist–Outstanding。原题与初始整稿已有完整审查；本版全部 23 页重新阅读并查看实际页面，新增成本、路线、复现与备忘录按原尺寸核对。行政封存超出预定 20 分钟复评窗口。
strength_en: Makes the search plan inspectable through 34 ordered surveys, depth layers and the full sortie clock. A conditional acquisition threshold compares readiness costs while separating discovery from the opportunity to complete recovery.
strength_zh: 以 34 次有序调查、深度层及完整出航时钟呈现可核查的搜索方案；准备状态的条件采购阈值把发现目标与完成回收的机会分开。
limits_en: Post-learning revision, not a first autonomous solution or actual award. Currents, detector likelihood, commercial availability and deep human-recovery interfaces remain scenario inputs. The small new recovery-route gain lacks across-seed calibration. The gallery provides the paper rather than its private complete case package; complete historical AI transcripts and formal 2024 compliance remain unauthenticated.
limits_zh: 学后修订，非首次自主解题或实际获奖。海流、探测似然、商业可用性及深海载人恢复接口仍为情景输入；新增路线的微小回收机会收益尚无跨种子校准。图库只提供论文，不附其私有完整案例包；历史完整 AI 聊天及 2024 正式合规仍未认证。
review_scope_en: Initial original four-page problem and complete 20-page paper with eight route/environment numerical checks retained. Current 23-page text and all actual pages; native added cost/route/depth/index and two-page memorandum review, with 56 independent incremental coordinate, readiness-threshold, unit and index checks.
review_scope_zh: 原题四页与初始 20 页整稿、八组路线／环境数值审查按原证据接续。本版全部 23 页文本与实际页面；新增成本／路线／深度／索引及两页备忘录原尺寸查看，另完成 56 项独立坐标、准备阈值、量纲和索引核验。
identity_zh: 学后完整作品 / complete post-learning work
identity_en: Complete post-learning work; no first-autonomous claim
reviewer_identity_zh: 作者外 AI 评阅；非真人同行评审或官方评委。
reviewer_identity_en: Author-external AI review; no human peer reviewer or official judge.
